task.request: At this fixed source ref, determine whether a verified non-admin user can write attacker-selected text to an existing knowledge-base collection for which the user has no write permission by supplying that collection name to POST /process/text.

policySources.text: A verified non-admin may write to an existing knowledge-base collection only when the user owns it or has an explicit write grant.
